mentions.name: Striga
mentions.description: This tool performs source code auditing built on AI, using local LLMs to audit code while ensuring full data sovereignty. It has uncovered vulnerabilities such as a Double Free and possible RCE in Apache HTTP Server's HTTP/2 implementation (CVE-2026-23918).
